isoMetadataDates.note: All four CI_Date entries in the ISO metadata read directly from the XML's own <gco:Date> elements — one publication date (1900-01-01) is a placeholder/unset sentinel value NLSC's own metadata template ships with, not a real date; the operative dates are creation=2020-08-20 and revision=2020-08-20, consistent with the filename.

provenance.isoMetadataProjectReference: 109年度行政區域圖編製及界線維護作業 ("FY109 [2020] Administrative Region Map Compilation and Boundary Maintenance Operations") — confirms this shapefile is a genuine NLSC boundary-maintenance deliverable, not an ad-hoc or unofficial export.
provenance.isoMetadataCrsField: EPSG:3824 (stated explicitly and literally inside the XML's own <gco:CharacterString>EPSG:3824</gco:CharacterString> — not inferred from the .prj file alone this round, cross-confirmed by both).

vintageHonesty.note: IMPORTANT — read before assuming this is strictly newer than the V2.4.5-original taiwan-atlas 2021.9.20 mirror it replaces. This file's own official ISO metadata dates it 2020-08-20, which is CHRONOLOGICALLY EARLIER than taiwan-atlas's 2021.9.20 npm publish date. This was investigated and disclosed, not glossed over — see the V2_4_5_OFFICIAL_HSINCHU_BOUNDARY_DATA_HOTFIX_CONTINUE completion report (07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md) for the full record. This round's own web-search-only check (this sandbox cannot fetch data.gov.tw directly) surfaced that dataset 7442's page-level 'metadata update time' shows 2025-12-16, but that is unrelated to whether the underlying GEOMETRY changed and could not be independently confirmed by downloading the actual current file — a human downloaded THIS 2020-08-20 file directly from the same dataset 7442 at the time of this hotfix, which is presumed to be what is currently offered for download there.
vintageHonesty.whyStillAdopted: Despite the older nominal date, this file was adopted as the new Production authority because: (1) it is a DIRECT official download (human-sourced, ISO-19115-metadata-verified, NLSC project-referenced) rather than a third-party npm mirror of unknown intermediate handling — a strictly stronger provenance chain regardless of the exact survey date; (2) a systematic geometry diff against the outgoing taiwan-atlas 2021.9.20 boundary (see this round's own diff-check evidence in 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md) found NO material difference — only ~0.04% of a dense reference grid disagreed, and every disagreement was a single grid cell (~300m) directly astride the existing boundary line, consistent with taiwan-atlas's own boundary being a mapshaper-SIMPLIFIED/quantized version of the SAME underlying county-level administrative line, not a genuine geometry revision; (3) Hsinchu City/County's county-level administrative boundary has not changed since Taiwan's 2014 direct-controlled-municipality restructuring, so no substantive difference between any two vintages of this dataset was ever expected at this granularity; (4) this file is HIGHER precision (unsimplified raw SHP: 4,027 points for 新竹市, 15,069 for 新竹縣) than the outgoing quantized TopoJSON (246 / 965 points) — a genuine precision upgrade even though the nominal survey date is earlier.

geometryDiffCheck.method: Point-in-polygon ray-casting (the SAME algorithm src/tdx/hsinchuGeoResolver.js#isPointInRings uses) evaluated for both the outgoing (taiwan-atlas 2021.9.20) and incoming (this file) Hsinchu City+County polygons, over (a) 10 known reference points spanning Hsinchu + 5 neighboring counties, (b) a dense ~300m grid across the 新竹/桃園 boundary region, (c) a dense ~300m grid across the 新竹/苗栗 boundary region, (d) a dense ~300m grid across the full extended bounding area.
geometryDiffCheck.referencePoints: 10/10 identical between old and new (新竹市政府/竹北市公所/湖口鄉/新豐鄉 all CONFIRMED both ways; 桃園市政府/桃園觀音區/苗栗市公所/頭份市公所/竹南鎮公所/台北市政府 all OUTSIDE both ways).
geometryDiffCheck.taoyuanBorderGrid: 1 / 4,131 points differ (0.024%) — a single boundary-edge cell.
geometryDiffCheck.miaoliBorderGrid: 1 / 5,751 points differ (0.017%) — a single boundary-edge cell.
geometryDiffCheck.fullRegionGrid: 19 / 47,089 points differ (0.0403%) — every disagreement is an isolated boundary-edge cell, none forms a contiguous region of material size.
geometryDiffCheck.conclusion: BOUNDARY_CHANGED=NO at any scale relevant to this resolver's own accuracy needs. The observed micro-differences are simplification/quantization artifacts of the OUTGOING taiwan-atlas TopoJSON, not a real administrative boundary revision.

notes: This is the WHOLE-NATION county/city shapefile (all 22 counties/cities), staged verbatim (SHP/SHX/DBF/PRJ/CPG + the accompanying official ISO metadata XML) under raw/nlsc-shp-2020/ for full traceability.

scripts/updateHsinchuBoundaryData.mjs is the ONLY reader of this directory — it parses the shapefile (via the `shapefile` npm package, a devDependency used only by this one-time/on-demand generator script, never bundled into the Cloudflare Worker), extracts ONLY the 新竹市 (COUNTYID=O, COUNTYCODE=10018) and 新竹縣 (COUNTYID=J, COUNTYCODE=10004) features into data/hsinchu-boundary/generated/hsinchuBoundary.js — the only file src/tdx/hsinchuGeoResolver.js actually reads at runtime.

The outgoing taiwan-atlas 2021.9.20 TopoJSON is preserved, NOT deleted, at raw/historical-taiwan-atlas-2021/ — kept as a historical comparison / test fixture per this hotfix order's own section 七, no longer Production authority.

CRS: EPSG:3824 (TWD97 經緯度), confirmed both from the .prj file (GCS_TWD_1997, GRS_1980 spheroid) and literally from the ISO metadata XML's own CRS field. TDX RoadEvent PositionLon/PositionLat are treated as plain WGS84 decimal degrees — this project's own pre-existing engineering precedent (see data/road-location/raw/README.md); TWD97 and WGS84 differ by only centimeters for Taiwan, several orders of magnitude smaller than TDX's own reported position accuracy, so no numerical coordinate transformation is applied. This is a disclosed engineering judgment about a well-established, small, uncontroversial geodetic fact, not a guess about the boundary GEOMETRY itself.
